## What this does

A one-line helper: writes a string followed by a newline to a file. It's
plumbing, not part of the method itself — used throughout `frescalo` to
write the log file and the headers of the output tables.

```{.rust filename="src/bin/frescalo.rs" tangle="frescalo__writeln"}
fn writeln<W: Write>(w: &mut W, s: &str) {
    w.write_all(s.as_bytes()).unwrap();
    w.write_all(b"\n").unwrap();
}
```
